title: Anchored Decoding: Provably Reducing Copyright Risk for Any Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2602.07120v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models (LMs) tend to memorize portions of their training data and emit verbatim spans. When the underlying sources are sensitive or copyright-protected, such reproduction raises issues of consent and compensation for creators and compliance risks for developers. We propose Anchored Decoding, a plug-and-play inference-time method for suppressing verbatim copying: it enables decoding from any risky LM trained on mixed-license data by keeping generation in bounded proximity to a permissively trained safe LM. Anchored Decoding adaptively allocates a user-chosen information budget over the generation trajectory and enforces per-step constraints that yield a sequence-level guarantee, enabling a tunable risk-utility trade-off. translated_title: 锚定解码：为任意语言模型提供可证明的版权风险降低
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LM）往往会记忆其训练数据中的部分内容，并逐字输出其中的片段。当底层来源是敏感内容或受版权保护的内容时，这种复现会引发创作者的同意与报酬问题，以及开发者的合规风险。我们提出锚定解码，这是一种即插即用的推理时方法，用于抑制逐字复制：通过将生成过程保持在宽松许可训练的安全模型的有界邻近范围内，它使得在任何基于混合许可数据训练的有风险语言模型上进行解码成为可能。锚定解码在生成轨迹上自适应地分配用户指定的信息预算，并强制执行每步约束以获得序列级保证，从而实现可调节的风险-效用权衡。为了使锚定解码具有实际应用价值，我们引入了一个新的宽松许可训练的安全模型TinyComma 1.8B，以及锚定字节解码——我们方法的字节级变体，它能够……
tldr: 提出即插即用的推理时“锚定解码”方法，通过将生成过程约束在宽松许可安全模型的有界邻近范围内，为任意语言模型提供可证明的序列级版权风险保证，实现可调节的风险-效用权衡，并配套发布了安全模型TinyComma 1.8B及字节级变体。
en_tdlr: Anchored Decoding is a plug-and-play inference-time method that provably reduces copyright risk for any language model by keeping generation within bounded proximity of a permissively trained safe model, providing sequence-level guarantees with a tunable risk-utility trade-off.
